pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān bǎ kuāng lǐ de shítou tiāo le chūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi first picked the stones out of the basket.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先把筐里的石头挑了出来。

pairs.english: Stones added weight on the scales.
Mixed into scrap iron for sale,
they could fetch an extra two copper coins;
if discovered,

pairs.target: zhè yìkuāng biàn lián shítou de jià yě bùzhí .
pairs.english: the whole basket would not be worth even the price of stones.
pairs.hanzi: 这一筐便连石头的价也不值。

pairs.target: sè lāguǎn zhè jiàozuò búhuì suànzhàng de tānxīn .
pairs.english: Sela called that greed without a head for figures.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉管这叫做不会算账的贪心。

pairs.english: He never added stones.

pairs.target: tā chān de shì kuāng dǐ nà kuài shībù .
pairs.english: What he added was the damp cloth at the bottom of the basket.
pairs.hanzi: 他掺的是筐底那块湿布。

pairs.english: “Wring it out.”
Sela had her back to him,
turning a flatbread beside the stove,

pairs.target: xiàng hòunǎosháo yě cháng le yǎnjīng .
pairs.english: as though eyes had grown in the back of her head as well.
“It was damp to begin with.”

pairs.target: " nǐ běnlái yě méi zhème duō huà . "
pairs.english: “You did not have so much to say to begin with, either.”
Tavi pulled out the cloth
and wrung it into the bucket beside the door.
The water was black enough to write with.
He felt a little sorry to lose it;

pairs.target: sè lā dì lái bànzhāng bǐng ,
pairs.english: Sela handed him half a flatbread.
He freed a hand to take it

pairs.target: fāxiàn hòu de nà bàn liúgěi le zìjǐ .
pairs.english: and found she had saved the thicker half for him.
pairs.hanzi: 发现厚的那半留给了自己。

pairs.english: “Do not take the northern ladder;

pairs.target: zuówǎn yòu diào le liǎngjí . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: it lost another two rungs last night,” she said.
He gave a grunt of assent,
held the flatbread between his teeth,
and lifted the basket.

pairs.target: zuǒbiān de tí ěr kuài duàn le ,
pairs.english: The handle on the left was about to break.
He supported it with his elbow

pairs.target: kuàguò ménkǒu shuìjiào de qué gǒu .
pairs.english: and stepped over the lame dog sleeping in the doorway.
The dog opened only one eye.
Recognizing it was him,

pairs.target: biàn lián rànglù de yìsī yě shěng le .
pairs.english: it did not even bother with the intention of getting out of the way.
pairs.hanzi: 便连让路的意思也省了。

pairs.english: The Ash Hollow had no sun yet.

pairs.target: tóudǐng de tóng jiē chéng yǐjīng liàng le ,
pairs.english: Copperstep, above his head, was already bright.
pairs.hanzi: 头顶的铜阶城已经亮了，

pairs.english: Tiers of rooftops spread along the mountainside,

pairs.target: zuìgāochù de chuāngzǐ bái dé cìyǎn .
pairs.english: the highest windows a dazzling white.
pairs.hanzi: 最高处的窗子白得刺眼。

pairs.target: huò tī cóng nàxiē chuāngzǐ xiàmiàn huǎnhuǎn jiàngxiàlái ,
pairs.english: The freight lift descended slowly from below those windows,
pairs.hanzi: 货梯从那些窗子下面缓缓降下来，

pairs.english: trailing six iron cables.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎoshíhòu yǐwéi tàiyáng shì shàngchéng fàng xiàlái de ,
pairs.english: As a child, Tavi thought the sun was lowered by the upper city,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维小时候以为太阳是上城放下来的，

pairs.english: just like flour and salt;

pairs.target: dé děng tāmen yòng gòu le cái lún dào zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: it only reached this place after they had had enough of it.
pairs.hanzi: 得等他们用够了才轮到这里。

pairs.english: Later Sela told him
it was called the mountain’s shadow.

pairs.target: shānyǐng bù shōuqián , suàn tā hòudào .
pairs.english: The mountain’s shadow charged nothing; that was decent of it.

pairs.target: tā yánzhe nánbiān de shíjiē wǎngxiàzǒu .
pairs.english: He walked down the stone steps on the southern side.
pairs.hanzi: 他沿着南边的石阶往下走。

pairs.english: At every bend,

pairs.target: kuāng lǐ de dànpiàn biàn xiǎng yízhèn .
pairs.english: the spring strips in the basket rattled for a moment.

pairs.target: nàxiē dōngxī cóng jiù yùn jù shàng chāixiàlái ,
pairs.english: Those things had been removed from old transport machinery,
pairs.hanzi: 那些东西从旧运具上拆下来，

pairs.english: of differing widths,

pairs.target: biānyuán dài zhe shāo guò de lánsè .
pairs.english: their edges bearing a blue tinge from heating.

pairs.target: zuótiān tā fēn dào zhè yìkuāng shí ,
pairs.english: When he was allotted this basket yesterday,
the foreman said the temper was ruined
and it could only be sold as mixed scrap iron;

pairs.target: tā què tiāochū le shíjǐpiàn hái néng yòng de ,
pairs.english: but he had picked out a dozen or so pieces that were still usable,
pairs.hanzi: 他却挑出了十几片还能用的，

pairs.english: planning to price them separately.
Enough to buy three days of stove coal.
Whenever Sela’s knees grew cold,
she could not sleep well at night.

pairs.target: shōu liào péng qiánpái zhe qībāgè rén .
pairs.english: Seven or eight people were queued outside the receiving shed.
pairs.hanzi: 收料棚前排着七八个人。

pairs.english: A new notice had replaced the old one on the wall,

pairs.target: zuì dǐxià gài zhe yígè zǐ yìn .
pairs.english: with a purple seal stamped at the very bottom.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènde tiě zì , yě rènde qián zì ,
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the character for iron, and the one for money,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认得铁字，也认得钱字，

pairs.english: but the rest, strung together,

pairs.target: xiàng yìpái bùkěn gěi tā rànglù de rén .
pairs.english: were like a line of people refusing to make way for him.
pairs.hanzi: 像一排不肯给他让路的人。

pairs.target: tā xiān kàn biérén de liǎn .
pairs.english: He looked at other people’s faces first.

pairs.target: qiánmiàn de hànzǐ bǎ qián shù le liǎngbiàn ,
pairs.english: The man ahead counted his money twice
pairs.hanzi: 前面的汉子把钱数了两遍，

pairs.english: without arguing,

pairs.target: wānyāo jiāng dàizǐ lǐ de fèi dīng chóngxīn zhājǐn .
pairs.english: then bent to tie up the scrap nails in his sack again.
pairs.hanzi: 弯腰将袋子里的废钉重新扎紧。

pairs.target: zhā dào dìsānquān , xìshéng duàn le .
pairs.english: On the third turn of the knot, the thin cord snapped.
He lowered his head to find the end of the cord,

pairs.target: hòumiàn de rén biàn dōu jìngxiàlái .
pairs.english: and everyone behind him fell silent.
When Tavi’s turn came,

pairs.target: shōu liào yuán méiyǒu pèng chèng .
pairs.english: the receiving clerk did not touch the scales.
“No spring strips accepted.
Orders from above.”
“Not even good ones?”
“They are good just because you say so?”
Tavi put down the basket,
picked out the most even piece,
and laid it on the edge of the counter.
“Try it, sir.”

pairs.target: shōu liào yuán shēnchū mǔzhǐ yì yā .
pairs.english: The clerk extended a thumb and pressed.
The steel strip bent;
released, it sprang back to its original shape.
He glanced at it

pairs.target: háishì bǎ tā bō jìntuì liào de mùpán .
pairs.english: but still flicked it into the wooden tray for rejects.
pairs.hanzi: 还是把它拨进退料的木盘。

pairs.english: “This batch has no inspection stamp.
Take it back.”
“You were still accepting them yesterday.”
“Yesterday was yesterday.”

pairs.target: hòumiàn yǒurén yòng kuāng pèng le pèng tǎ wéi de xiǎotuǐ .
pairs.english: Someone behind him nudged Tavi’s lower leg with a basket.
pairs.hanzi: 后面有人用筐碰了碰塔维的小腿。

pairs.english: He moved aside,

pairs.target: bān dào péngwài de ǎiqiáng biān ,
pairs.english: carried the basket to a low wall outside the shed,
and crouched down to sort it again.
Intact pieces on the left,
cracked ones on the right.

pairs.target: suì zhā guī tā , sè lā shuō guò ;
pairs.english: The scrap was his, Sela had said;

pairs.target: zhǐyào fēn de xì , zǒng yǒurén yòngdéshàng .
pairs.english: as long as he sorted it finely enough, someone could always use it.
pairs.hanzi: 只要分得细，总有人用得上。

pairs.target: tā ná qǐ yípiàn wānqū de báo tiě dài ,
pairs.english: He picked up a thin, bent strip of iron,
pairs.hanzi: 他拿起一片弯曲的薄铁带，

pairs.target: xiǎng guādiào dànpiàn shàng de yóugòu .
pairs.english: intending to scrape the grease off the spring strip.
The two pieces of iron rested together in his palm,
cold enough to hurt.
He applied pressure;

pairs.target: dànpiàn hūrán shùnzhe mǔzhǐ ruǎn xiàqù ,
pairs.english: the spring strip suddenly yielded beneath his thumb,
pairs.hanzi: 弹片忽然顺着拇指软下去，

pairs.target: wān guò le yuánběn bùkěn wān de dìfāng .
pairs.english: bending past the point where it had previously refused to bend.
pairs.hanzi: 弯过了原本不肯弯的地方。

pairs.english: Tavi stopped.
It had been perfectly fine just now.

pairs.target: tā qù bāi pángbiān nàtiáo tiě dài ,
pairs.english: He tried to straighten the iron strip beside it,
but to his surprise could not make it straight.
Such a thin little strip,

pairs.target: juè dé xiàng guìtái hòumiàn de rén .
pairs.english: as stubborn as the man behind the counter.

pairs.target: tā huàn le gè wòfǎ zài shì ,
pairs.english: He changed his grip and tried again,
but his fingertips went numb,
and the iron strip slipped from his hand
into a gap between the stones.
A brass bell rang behind him.
He looked up.

pairs.target: yígè nǚrén yánzhe shíjiē zǒu xiàlái ,
pairs.english: A woman was walking down the stone steps,
pairs.hanzi: 一个女人沿着石阶走下来，

pairs.target: wàitào de xiàbǎi quán shì gān ní ,
pairs.english: the hem of her coat covered in dried mud,
a long, flat pack slung over her shoulder.

pairs.target: shǒu péng de rén běnlái zuò zhe ,
pairs.english: The man guarding the shed had been sitting,

pairs.target: kànjiàn tā jǐng jiān lùchū de bái pái ,
pairs.english: but at the sight of the white tally showing at her neck,
pairs.hanzi: 看见她颈间露出的白牌，

pairs.english: he stood up

pairs.target: bǎ dǎnglù de liàochē wǎng lǐ tuī le tuī .
pairs.english: and pushed the obstructing scrap cart a little farther inside.
pairs.hanzi: 把挡路的料车往里推了推。

pairs.english: An Outrider.
Tavi had seen pictures.

pairs.target: huà shàng de rén zǒng pī zhe dà dǒupeng ,
pairs.english: The people in the pictures always wore great cloaks,
pairs.hanzi: 画上的人总披着大斗篷，

pairs.target: zhàn zài méi rén qùguò de shānkǒu ,
pairs.english: standing at mountain passes no one had ever reached,

pairs.target: lián tóufa dōu bǐ biérén chuī dé yuǎn .
pairs.english: even their hair blown farther than anyone else’s.
pairs.hanzi: 连头发都比别人吹得远。

pairs.target: yǎnqián zhèwèi zhèng yòng yáchǐ chě shǒutào shàng de xiàntóu ,
pairs.english: This one in front of him was pulling a loose thread on her glove with her teeth;
pairs.hanzi: 眼前这位正用牙齿扯手套上的线头，

pairs.english: after two tugs failed to break it,
she simply left it alone.

pairs.target: bái pái shàng yǒu sāndào héng hén .
pairs.english: There were three horizontal notches on the white tally.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bù zhīdào sāndào shì shénme yìsī .
pairs.english: Tavi did not know what three meant.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不知道三道是什么意思。

pairs.target: tā zhī zhīdào huī ào de háizi ná mù piànkè zhèzhǒng pái ,
pairs.english: He only knew that children in the Ash Hollow carved tallies like these from bits of wood,
pairs.hanzi: 他只知道灰坳的孩子拿木片刻这种牌，

pairs.english: hung them around their necks,

pairs.target: néng dāng yí xiàwǔ de shǒulǐng .
pairs.english: and got to be the leader for an afternoon.
When it was time to eat,

pairs.target: shǒulǐng zhàoyàng dé āijiā qù jiào rén .
pairs.english: the leader still had to go door to door calling everyone.
pairs.hanzi: 首领照样得挨家去叫人。

pairs.english: The woman put her pack on the counter.

pairs.target: shōu liào yuán mǒ le yìbǎ guìmiàn ,
pairs.english: The clerk gave the counter a wipe;

pairs.target: fāngcái duì tǎ wéi shuōhuà de shēngyīn bújiàn le .
pairs.english: the voice he had used to speak to Tavi a moment ago was gone.
pairs.hanzi: 方才对塔维说话的声音不见了。

pairs.english: She did not stay long.

pairs.target: chūlái shí , shǒulǐ duō le zhāng zhǐ ,
pairs.english: When she came out, she had gained a sheet of paper in her hand,
the pack still on her shoulder.
Reaching the low wall,

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn le kàn dìshàng de liǎngpái tiěpiàn .
pairs.english: she looked down at the two rows of iron pieces on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头看了看地上的两排铁片。

pairs.english: “Why separate them?”
“Different prices.”
“But is he not refusing them?”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ liè de nà piàn fānguòlái ,
pairs.english: Tavi turned the cracked piece over,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把裂的那片翻过来，

pairs.english: so that the crack faced upwards.
“Someone will take them.”
The woman crouched down.

pairs.target: tā de zhǐjiǎ pī le yìjiǎo ,
pairs.english: One corner of her fingernail was split,

pairs.target: lǐmiàn qiàn zhe báisè de xìshā .
pairs.english: fine white sand embedded inside.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù kàn nà yìdiǎn bái ;
pairs.english: Tavi could not help looking at that tiny speck of white;
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住看那一点白；

pairs.target: huī ào de shā , cónglái zhǐyǒu huīsè .
pairs.english: sand in the Ash Hollow was always grey.
pairs.hanzi: 灰坳的沙，从来只有灰色。

pairs.target: tā cóng bāo lǐ qǔchū liǎngzhī jiù dākòu ,
pairs.english: She took two old clasps out of her pack
pairs.hanzi: 她从包里取出两只旧搭扣，

pairs.english: and placed them on the side with the intact pieces.

pairs.target: " zhège , nǐ fēn de chūlái ma ? "
pairs.english: “Can you sort these?”
He did not reach for them immediately.
“If I sort them wrong, do I have to pay?”

pairs.target: " fēn bù chūlái jiù shuō fēn bù chūlái .
pairs.english: “If you cannot tell, say you cannot tell.
No deductions.”
“How much?”
She named a sum.

pairs.target: gòumǎi méi , hái néng shèng yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Enough to buy coal, with a little left over.
Tavi watched her,
waiting for what she would say next.

pairs.target: tā què yǐjīng bǎ tóngqián fàngdào qiángtóu ,
pairs.english: But she had already put the copper coins on top of the wall,
pairs.hanzi: 她却已经把铜钱放到墙头，

pairs.english: holding one of them down
to keep it from rolling away.
“I will come tomorrow morning.

pairs.target: bù jí , shǒu nuǎn le zài zuò . "
pairs.english: No hurry. Do it when your hands are warm.”
She stood up,

pairs.target: ràngkāi le luòdào qiángbiān de yìxiǎokuài yángguāng .
pairs.english: stepping out of a small patch of sunlight that had reached the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 让开了落到墙边的一小块阳光。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu xiān ná qián .
pairs.english: Tavi did not take the money first.

pairs.target: tā shēnchū dòng má de shǒu ,
pairs.english: He held out his cold-numbed hands,

pairs.target: bǎ liǎngzhī dākòu wǎng guāng lǐ nuó le nuó .
pairs.english: and shifted the two clasps a little into the light.
pairs.hanzi: 把两只搭扣往光里挪了挪。
